📄 firebase.json que funciona ​

json
{
  "hosting": {
    "public": "dist/domflix/browser",
    "ignore": ["firebase.json", "**/.*", "**/node_modules/**"],
    "rewrites": [{ "source": "**", "destination": "/index.html" }],
    "headers": [
      {
        "source": "**/*.@(js|css)",
        "headers": [{ "key": "Cache-Control", "value": "max-age=31536000" }]
      }
    ]
  }
}
